title: Wolfskopf — Murmansk 24.01.1942
description: Titovka. Arctic winter. The wolf on your fuselage is blue. You have been flying since dawn.
author: Markus Leutwyler
narrative: The wolf on your fuselage is blue.
You have been flying since dawn.
You do not know her name. You know her handwriting.
debrief: Did you maintain heading in the crosswind?
Did you feel the gyroscopic pull on left turns?
